title: Fun twists, unexpected finds: Top 5 holiday food & beverage trends at Target
summary: Discover 5 holiday food trends at Target, from nostalgic candy and creative baking kits to unique food gifts and festive finds at an incredible value.
body_markdown:
This holiday season, Target is bringing guests **250+ new holiday food and beverage items** and **400+ holiday exclusives** that combine to capture the magic of the biggest trends and create moments of discovery all season long. From nostalgic candy and playful baking kits to unexpected food gifts guests will love to give, the Target team is putting a fresh spin on the season. And with nearly 80% of Target's owned-brand holiday food and beverage items priced at **$5 or less** , guests can find something special at an incredible value.


“Food creates many of the moments that make the holidays memorable, so Target has curated an assortment that includes all of the trends we know our guests can’t wait to try with options for every budget,” said **John Conlin** , SVP of merchandising, food and beverage, Target. “We’re committed to using our merchandising authority to extend style and design into our Food aisles because we know our guests want to be inspired – with creative products and beautiful packaging that make the season feel special.”


Food is at the heart of holiday traditions and our trend and culinary team is there to help guests find new ways to elevate their favorites so every celebration feels special. This holiday, that means playful twists on nostalgic favorites and unexpected new discoveries busy families will love trying and sharing with loved ones,” said **Diane Douglas** , director of owned brand food and beverage product development, culinary and trend, Target.

### A sweet dose of nostalgia


Classic holiday treats are getting a playful refresh with fun, unexpected twists, delicious new flavors, and festive packaging.


**What to discover:**


- **Favorite Day's first-ever nostalgic candy collection** , including[Old Fashioned Ribbon Candy](https://www.target.com/p/old-fashioned-candy-5-6oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95106279#lnk=sametab) and candy jars at $5 and $8 price points, plus holiday snack and candy tins.
- **Favorite Day candy canes** , featuring fun new flavors like[coconut eggnog](https://www.target.com/p/coconut-eggnog-candy-canes-5-3oz-12ct-favorite-day-8482/-/A-94902263) and[winter punch](https://www.target.com/p/winter-citrus-candy-canes-5-3oz-12ct-favorite-day-8482/-/A-94902262#lnk=sametab) , plus oversized[options](https://www.target.com/p/jumbo-swirly-candy-green-red-white-17-64oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95093348#lnk=sametab) that make big surprises for little ones.
- **Favorite Day sugar cookie-flavored Milk for Santa and new candy cane-flavored Milk for Elves** , both arriving Nov. 29, add a playful twist to the tradition of leaving out a holiday treat.[Favorite Day Color-Changing Cocoa](https://www.target.com/p/holiday-color-changing-cocoa-5ct-6-2oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-91081723#lnk=sametab) adds another fun surprise to a classic holiday drink.


### Play with your food


Baking, decorating and making drinks give families a chance to create something together, and this season's assortment makes it easy to join the fun.


**What to discover:**


- **Baked by Melissa** , new and exclusive bite-size[cupcake kits](https://www.target.com/b/baked-by-melissa/-/N-q643lesf2ej) , including marshmallow hot cocoa, red velvet and tie dye mixes, plus bite-size cupcake pans and liners.
- **More than a dozen creative gingerbread and cookie kits** , with one-third of the assortment new this year, including the Favorite Day[Prebuilt Holiday Coloring Village Gingerbread Kit](https://www.target.com/p/prebuilt-holiday-coloring-village-gingerbread-cookie-kits-24oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95095516) ,[Modern Stacking Tree Cookie Kit](https://www.target.com/p/modern-stacking-tree-cookie-kit-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95103951) and[Bullseye’s Dog House Cookie Kit](https://www.target.com/p/bullseye-39-s-dog-house-kit-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95103950) .
- **Festive drink toppers and treats** , including Favorite Day[Snowman Puddles Hot Drink Decorating Kit](https://www.target.com/p/snowman-puddles-hot-cocoa-holiday-marshmallow-kit-7-2oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95088384) ,[Merry Makers Marshmallows](https://www.target.com/p/trees-santa-and-gingerbread-men-marshmallows-12ct-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95088235) in Santa, tree and gingerbread shapes and[Candy Cane Spoons](https://www.target.com/p/peppermint-christmas-candy-cane-spoons-7-6oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-94586631) .
- **Finishing touches for holiday baking** , including Favorite Day[Shimmer Ornament-Shaped Sprinkle Bottle](https://www.target.com/p/christmas-shimmer-ornament-shaped-sprinkle-bottle-4-59oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95088176) ,[Ugly Sweater Holiday Icing Decorations](https://www.target.com/p/ugly-sweater-icing-decorations-0-35oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95088006#lnk=sametab) and[White Cherry Cotton Candy Crumbles](https://www.target.com/p/white-cherry-cotton-candy-crumbles-1-5oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95094576#lnk=sametab) .


### Gifts with good taste


Food gifts are getting a creative upgrade, with specialty finds, unexpected flavor combinations and beautifully packaged options for hosts, food lovers and anyone who appreciates a delicious surprise.


**What to discover:**


- **Specialty food finds** , including expanded[Marks & Spencer](https://www.target.com/c/marks-spencer/-/N-s80gx) and[Harry & David](https://www.target.com/b/harry-david/-/N-q643leuu70x) assortments, plus[Favorite Day painted truffles](https://www.target.com/p/painted-truffles-candy-cherry-flavored-4-5oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95106312) and a[Fishwife tinned fish gift set](https://www.target.com/p/fishwife-tinned-seafood-co-holiday-gift-set-wild-caught-smoked-trout-salmon-7-4oz/-/A-1011032474#lnk=sametab) .
- **Distinctive food and drink gifts** , including[RYZE mushroom coffee gift set](https://www.target.com/p/ryze-vanilla-latte-holiday-gift-bundle/-/A-1011189597) ,[Jade Leaf matcha starter set](https://www.target.com/p/jade-leaf-matcha-starter-set-1-76oz/-/A-1011383783) and[Proper syrups](https://www.target.com/b/proper-syrup/-/N-q643lec9kk0) for at-home coffee makers.
- **Standout host gifts** , such as[Favorite Day Gummy Charcuterie](https://www.target.com/p/christmas-tree-gummy-entertaining-tray-24oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95106280#lnk=sametab) ,[Hearth & Hand with Magnolia Hot Cocoa Bar Jars](https://www.target.com/p/cocoa-bar-in-glass-latch-jars-15-2oz-hearth-38-hand-8482-with-magnolia/-/A-95079612) and[Hot Creek Mountain Mulled Wine](https://www.target.com/p/hot-creek-mountain-red-mulled-wine-750ml/-/A-1010860089) , available in red, white and a nonalcoholic option.


### Tiny treasures


The mini trend is taking over the holidays, with bite-sized treats, playful surprises and tiny creations that bring big joy to the season.


**What to discover:**


- **Stocking stuffer surprises for $5 or less** , including Favorite Day[Felted Wish Envelope](https://www.target.com/p/felted-wish-envelope-with-mini-stars-candy-3-17oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95093340) filled with tiny gummy stars,[Gold Shimmer Chocolate Present Smash](https://www.target.com/p/gold-shimmered-present-smash-with-sprinkles-38-mini-red-green-chocolate-gems-2-3oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95106126) that reveals mini sweets and[Star Lollipops](https://www.target.com/p/cherry-38-green-apple-star-lollipops-with-popping-candy-1-98oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95093344) with popping candy.
- **Mini gingerbread creations** , including Favorite Day mini gingerbread[houses](https://www.target.com/p/mini-holiday-gingerbread-house-kit-8oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95095517#lnk=sametab) ,[villages](https://www.target.com/p/mini-village-gingerbread-kit-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95102692#lnk=sametab) and[color-your-own mini village kits](https://www.target.com/p/prebuilt-holiday-coloring-village-gingerbread-cookie-kits-24oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95095516) that bring hands-on holiday fun to a smaller scale.
- **Hot cocoa with a twist** , including Favorite Day hot drink bombs with mini marshmallow[snowman](https://www.target.com/p/christmas-hot-chocolate-drink-bomb-belgian-milk-chocolate-topped-with-sprinkles-1-6oz-1ct-favorite-day-8482/-/A-88298574#lnk=sametab) ,[penguin](https://www.target.com/p/silver-shimmered-ornament-chocolate-with-penguin-marshmallow-inside-1-6oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95106305#lnk=sametab) and[snowflake](https://www.target.com/p/blue-shimmered-ornament-chocolate-with-snowflake-marshmallow-inside-1-4oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95106306#lnk=sametab) surprises.
- **Festive countdowns** , including Favorite Day[Milk Chocolate](https://www.target.com/p/24-day-milk-chocolate-advent-calendar-candy-1-9oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95115597) and[Gummy](https://www.target.com/p/24-day-gummy-candy-advent-calendar-10-7oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95106270) Advent Calendars, Good & Gather[Espresso Countdown Calendar](https://www.target.com/p/holiday-countdown-calendar-espresso-roast-coffee-pods-24ct-good-38-gather-8482/-/A-94308298) and Marks & Spencer[Percy Pig Countdown Calendar](https://www.target.com/p/m-38-s-christmas-percy-pig-advent-candy-38-chocolate-calendar-8-8oz/-/A-1011885124) .


### Elevate the everyday


This season, everyday food gets a festive twist, with elevated flavors and convenient options that make it easy to bring something special to the table.


**What to discover:**


- **Main dishes** , including[Market Pantry Tree-Shaped Pepperoni Pizza](https://www.target.com/p/tree-shaped-pizza-14-55oz-market-pantry-8482/-/A-95107782) and[Good & Gather Five Cheese Tree-Shaped Ravioli](https://www.target.com/p/five-cheese-tree-shaped-ravioli-9oz-good-38-gather-8482/-/A-95150113) .
- **Seasonal snacks** , including[Good & Gather Holiday Apple Spice Granola](https://www.target.com/p/holiday-apple-spice-granola-breakfast-granola-10oz-good-38-gather-8482/-/A-95241202) ,[Holiday Pretzels](https://www.target.com/p/holiday-shaped-pretzel-16oz-good-38-gather-8482/-/A-95242867) in festive shapes,[Favorite Day Red & Green Tortilla Chips](https://www.target.com/p/tortilla-chips-favorite-day/-/A-1011129697) and popcorn mixes in[Cherry & Chipotle](https://www.target.com/p/cherry-chipotle-holiday-popcorn-5-5oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95081138) and[Peppermint & White Chocolate](https://www.target.com/p/peppermint-38-white-chocolate-holiday-popcorn-5-5oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95081140) .
- **Festive drinks and coffee additions** , including Good & Gather[Cookie Butter Coffee Pods](https://www.target.com/p/naturally-flavored-cookie-butter-with-other-natural-flavors-light-roast-coffee-pods-16ct-good-38-gather-8482/-/A-95172485) and[Peppermint Coffee Syrup](https://www.target.com/p/peppermint-naturally-flavored-coffee-syrup-12-7oz-good-38-gather-8482/-/A-90912040) , plus Favorite Day[Creme Brulee Whipped Dairy Topping](https://www.target.com/p/cr-232-me-brulee-whipped-dairy-topping-13oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95121260) and[Holiday Nog Cold Foam](https://www.target.com/p/holiday-nog-cold-foam-13oz-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95121286) .
- **Holiday desserts** , including Favorite Day[Peppermint Ice Cream Bites](https://www.target.com/p/naturally-flavored-peppermint-ice-cream-bites-12ct-favorite-day-8482/-/A-95128845) and[Gingerbread Cookie Ice Cream Sandwiches](https://www.target.com/p/gingerbread-ice-cream-sandwich-14-56oz-4ct-favorite-day-8482/-/A-94291629) .
